summary: FINAL export verification (iteration 10). Backend: all 20 pytest tests pass (test_gyro_repeater, test_rot_vtg, test_tcp_nmea). /api/health returns simulator=true, fresh age (~0.05s), packets increasing (10584+). Static serving: GET / -> 200 text/html, GET /favicon.ico -> 200 image/x-icon.
